item.title: Ask HN: Good content on using AI to modernize professional services delivery
item.summary: I'm curious if the HN community has a good resources (blogs, podcasts, other content) on practical uses of SOTA AI to improve professional services (e.g. outsourced finance, etc.) I've read a fair amount of what people think should be done (theory) but haven't found a ton of content from people who actually have done it (practice) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49345255 Points: 5 # Comments: 1
